title: ledger's ui sync runs npm where there is no package.json, and misses three steps
foundBy: deps-maintenance campaign, pilots 1 and 2: the pilot2 orchestrator's findings (campaign-workspaces/deps-maintenance/pilot2/archives/deps-pilot2-20260922T203209Z/orchestrator/output/findings.md) and the step corrections pilot3's coordination.md section 5 carries
details:
`ledger:sync:ui-npm-codesweep-ai-ui` emits `npm install --save-exact @codesweep-ai/ui@dev` in `viewer` and again in `internal/ledger`. The second directory holds no `package.json`, only the `UIVersion` string in `render.go` that a pin in `deps-config.json` reads, so the command would create one. The version string needs an edit, not a command.

The action also cannot be done without three steps no manifest states. `viewer/index.html`, the bundle `assets.go` embeds, has to be rebuilt. Both committed pages, `ledger/ledger.html` and `fixtures/sandbox/ledger/ledger.html`, have to be re-rendered. `RendererVersion` has to move, as ledger's CONTRIBUTING.md requires when the rendered output changes. pilot1 found all three the hard way.
